reviews.title: Great RAM, Fast, stable, no issues.
reviews.comment:
Awesome, super fast, stable R A M.
If you buy these you already know it's easy to install. Drop the ram tabs, pull out old, press in new until it clicks. My PC had 16gb, but the new 32gb at a faster hz is impressive. No issues, was noticed/found on start up. I would recommend using their website to properly match up your ram needs, to your own opinion. I was wrong about what speed I could use, to my betterment.
reviews.author: Psychofisherman

reviews.title: Low voltage, low heat, and high performance!
reviews.comment: Swapped to this pair after running another pair teamgroup. The decreased temperatures from the lower voltage this pair has compared to other gaming RAM has saved me several degrees worth of temperature. These things run stable and smooth. Resolved all blue screen and shutdown issues teamgroup was giving me. 6000MHz RAM is perfect for getting a bit of a bonus with AMD's infinity fabric. 48GB is great! Just wish they offered this speed in 64! The timings could be better too, but if stability is your goal, and performance  as well, especially on AMD, I would heavily recommend these.
